name: novel-voice-cast-desktop
description: Secure Electron desktop runner for the Novel Voice Cast pipeline
author: caiyilian

scripts.verify: npm run verify:fixture && npm run verify:versions && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package:dir: npm run prepare:electron && npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_GET_USE_PROXY=true ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.ts
scripts.package:win: npm run prepare:electron && npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_GET_USE_PROXY=true ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ electron-builder --win nsis --publish never --config electron-builder.config.ts
